lore:
She begged the gladiator to kill her.
"Soon, they will find me, humiliate me, and then behead me, just as they did to my parents.
I refuse to die at the hands of those despicable worms, but you... you're different.
This is my only request—kill me."
The gladiator laughed heartily, his chest vibrating, chains clinking.
Her plea did not move him, but he never refused fresh blood offered to him.
